description.zh: 动态路由的内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入200个内网访问应用ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Application**时，必填。和**TagIds**二选一。当**ApplicationType**为**All**时，禁止输入。
description.en: A collection of internal network access application IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 200 internal network access application IDs. Required when ApplicationType is **Application**. Choose one of **ApplicationIds** or **TagIds**. Do not enter when **ApplicationType** is **All**.

description.zh:
动态路由的应用类型。取值：
- **All**：全部应用。
- **Application**：应用。
- **Tag**：标签。
description.en:
The application type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

- **All**: All applications.

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag.

description.zh: 动态路由描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格。
description.en: The dynamic route description. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

description.zh: 动态路由类型。取值：**connector**：自有专线。
description.en: The dynamic route type. Valid values: **connector**: Leased line.

description.zh: 动态路由名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The dynamic route name. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
动态路由下一跳实例ID。取值来源：
 - [ListConnectors](~~611545~~)：批量查询Connector。
description.en:
The next hop instance ID of the dynamic route. Source:

- For more information, see [ListConnectors](): Query Connectors in batches.

description.zh: 动态路由优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1-99。
description.en: The dynamic route priority. 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1-99.

description.zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表。
description.en: A list of regions supported by SASE POP cluster access points.

description.zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The dynamic route status. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入40个内网访问标签ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Tag**时，必填。和**ApplicationIds**二选一。当**ApplicationType**为**All**时，禁止输入。
description.en: A collection of internal network access tag IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 40 internal network access tag IDs. Required when ApplicationType is **Tag**. Choose one of **ApplicationIds** or **TagIds**. Do not enter when **ApplicationType** is **All**.

descriptions.zh: 默认最多可创建100个动态路由。
descriptions.en: By default, you can create a maximum of 100 dynamic routes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas create-dynamic-route --name dynamic_route_name --description '这是一条动态路由' --status Disabled --priority 99 --region-ids ap-southeast-1 --application-type Application --application-ids pa-application-7a44458978560000 --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --dynamic-route-type connector --next-hop connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas CreateDynamicRoute --region cn-hangzhou --Status Disabled --ApplicationType Application --Description '这是一条动态路由' --Priority 99 --NextHop 'connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000' --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationIds.1 'pa-application-7a44458978560000' --DynamicRouteType connector --RegionIds.1 'ap-southeast-1' --Name dynamic_route_name --method POST --force
